row:
I help cat owners avoid or treat medical or behavioral problems with non-fluff (debunking) facts, tips and trics.

I do this by talking about how you can do certain things yourself (DIY and tutorials), what is a fact or fiction about certain topics and what certain symptoms can mean so you get to know your lovely fluffy housemate better and better each time I release a new video.

FREE Quiz!!! https://vetnele.com/quiz/

I've been a veterinarian for cats (and dogs) since 2013.
I have a practice in Belgium (Aalst) with a Catfriendly Clinic label which insures low stress for cats in my practice. 

Never take my advice as a diagnosis! But as a guideline to see what might have to be done next. Please consult your vet if you have any doubts. You're always free to ask me any question in the comments.
